test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Pranay starts from Point A and drives 45 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 35 km, turns right and drives 75 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 25 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 30 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

 Pranay starts from Point A and drives 45 km towards North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 35 km, turns right and drives 75 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 25 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 30 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/911b765226c0931414ad328e3c9b2a3b9c8fd3486cb49ea5f18247ea10889605.png] 

Thus, he drive 10 km towards West in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
